title: ADA Method-Parameter Template Registry
description: Registry of reusable schema:PropertyValueSpecification method-parameter templates derived from technique TAPP spreadsheets. Each $def constrains one method-level (readOnly:true) parameter template (e.g. DriftCorrection, massAbsorptionCoefficients). TAPP building blocks reference these definitions via fragment $refs (schema.yaml#/$defs/<name>) so they resolve locally through the building-block register. The root only hosts $defs; it has no instantiable properties of its own.
